# Getting help

- **Setup and usage:** start with the [README](../README.md). It covers
  installation, RTP-MIDI setup on Windows, hotkeys, triggering behaviour, the
  configuration file, and troubleshooting for `python-rtmidi` builds.
- **Found a bug?** Open a
  [bug report](https://github.com/GiorgosKoulouris/livecues-videocues/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Have an idea?** Open a
  [feature request](https://github.com/GiorgosKoulouris/livecues-videocues/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security problem?** Report it privately as described in
  [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open a public issue.

This is a project maintained in spare time, so replies may take a few days.
